summary: Cloud & Backend Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and implementing highly scalable, production‑grade systems on AWS. Expert in serverless architectures, event‑driven workflows, and AI/LLM integration using Node.js, TypeScript and Python. Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into secure, performant cloud‑native solutions with IaC and CI/CD best practices.

key_competencies.name: Serverless & Event‑Driven Systems
